name: Carousel Patterns
description: Full-screen set of image cards that fan in, then arrange as a draggable wheel, wave, staggered grid, grid, fan or 3D depth layout, chosen with the variant prop.
contents: Twelve image cards with optional zero-padded number labels
behavior: Cards scale in one by one, then glide into the chosen layout
Circle and fan layouts can be dragged to rotate with inertia
Wave layout bobs continuously, stagger shifts vertically with the mouse, depth tilts the scene with the mouse
Changing the variant prop animates cards to the new layout, window resize re-lays out the cards
editableByProps: Card images, count, size, corner radius and number labels
Background color, font family, wheel radius and transition speed

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the stagger grid columns and rows
Change card shadow or number label style

fixed: Depth layout supports only the first 12 cards
Stagger layout uses a fixed 4 by 3 grid
Adds a stylesheet link for the TheGoodMonolith font to the document head and removes it on unmount
Layouts are sized from the window size, so the component is meant to fill the viewport

options.look: Cards spaced around a draggable wheel that stays upright as it spins
options.useWhen: A hero or portfolio opener that invites the visitor to spin through work

options.look: Cards in a row with a gently bobbing sine wave
options.useWhen: A calm, ambient strip of work under a headline

options.look: Offset 4 by 3 brick grid that shifts vertically with the mouse
options.useWhen: A project index where hovering around feels alive

options.look: Even responsive grid of scaled cards

options.look: Cards fanned like a hand, draggable to rotate
